title: Service bundles
description: Several services offered at one price (e.g. Spring bundle): contents, total duration, branches and bundle price.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view bundles.
load_failed: Bundles could not be loaded. Try again.
empty_description: Package services that are often booked together as one offer.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters or clear the search.
create_description: Pick the services in order, then set the bundle price and the branches that offer it.
edit_description: Contents, price and branches can change; existing bookings keep their lines and prices.
detail_description: The bundle's price, contents, how the discount is spread over the services, and its history.
detail_not_found: The bundle was not found or you have no access.
columns.name: Name
form.section_identity_desc: Name and description customers see, order and visibility.
form.section_items_desc: Add the services in the order they are served. Each service becomes its own booking line; its staff member and resources are checked separately.
form.section_price_desc: The bundle price is spread over the services by their list prices; the rounding difference goes to the last service.
form.section_branches_desc: Branches that offer the bundle. Every branch must offer all services of the bundle.
fields.name: Bundle name
fields.sort_order_hint: Lower numbers come first in lists.
fields.show_online_hint: When off, the bundle is sold from the panel only.
fields.is_active_hint: An inactive bundle takes no new bookings.
fields.description_hint: Briefly describe what the bundle includes and saves.
fields.price_hint: The total the customer pays for the bundle.
summary.staff_required: At least one service needs a staff member
detail.items_desc: The bundle price is spread over the services by their list prices. A booking splits it again over the branch and staff prices; staff earnings follow these shares.
validation.name_max: Bundle name can be at most 160 characters.
validation.items_min: A bundle needs at least {{min}} services.
validation.items_max: A bundle can hold at most {{max}} services.
validation.sort_order: Order must be a whole number between 0 and 100000.
